title: GridNodeMasterData
description: Reference data for a low-voltage grid node, feeder, or transformer area. Looked up at runtime by gridNodeId to enrich TAF10GridReading messages with operational thresholds and controllable assets.

gridNodeName.description: Human-readable grid node or feeder name.

operator.description: Distribution system operator responsible for this grid node.

gridNodeType.description: Operational role of this node in the low-voltage grid.

maxLoadW.description: Operational load threshold in W before mitigation is considered.

maxFeedInW.description: Operational feed-in threshold in W, e.g. photovoltaic export limit for this segment.

voltageMinV.description: Lower voltage band limit in V.

voltageMaxV.description: Upper voltage band limit in V.

controllableAssets.description: Assets that may receive switching or curtailment commands.

location.description: Fixed installation coordinates of the grid node.

frostThingId.description: FROST-Server @iot.id of the STA Thing entity corresponding to this grid node. Populated after initial sync.

frostDatastreamIds.description: Maps electrical quantities to their FROST Datastream @iot.id. Populated after initial sync.
